records.part: Predictive Arrival and Departure System (PADS) upgrade/replacement integrated with Visual Message Sign (VMS) system
records.reason: This project is to upgrade and replace the existing PADS with more dependable predictions for train arrival and departure, integrated with the Visual Message Sign (VMS) system

records.part: Precast Mini High Platforms for ADA access at Capital, Blossom Hill, Morgan Hill, San Martin, and Gilroy stations
records.reason: This project will include installation of precast platforms and modifications to existing infrastructure, as needed, to accommodate the installation.
records.installed_location: Capital, Blossom Hill, Morgan Hill, San Martin, and Gilroy stations

records.part: Broadband Wireless Communication System (Wi-Fi) for diesel trains
records.reason: This project is to provide passengers Wi-Fi service on the existing diesel trains.

records.part: Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Radio Dispatch System replacing analog voice dispatch center
records.reason: The existing voice dispatch center implemented in 2012 operates on analog technology and has become obsolete. It lacks the capacity to accommodate the updated digital voice radio system.

records.part: Mid-life overhaul of locomotives including diesel engine disassembly, reconditioning, and Separate Head-End Power (SEP-HEP) unit replacement
records.reason: This project will perform a mid-life overhaul of six MP-36-3C Locomotives.

records.part: Continuous acoustic emissions monitoring system for San Francisquito Creek Bridge to detect cracking/fatigue risk
records.reason: install continuous acoustic emissions monitoring system to enhance risk management by providing more timely notice of potential cracks or damage on the truss, chord, and main verticals.

records.part: Overhead Catenary System (OCS) update and design for San Mateo parking 'set out track'
records.reason: This project is to enact an update to the San Mateo parking track OCS from the existing environmental clearance report and complete the final design for a "set out track"
records.installed_location: San Mateo (Bay Meadows area, between 10th and 14th Avenues)
